metadata.description: Vault-first Claude Code toolkit: a curated set of plugins over an Obsidian knowledge base, with contracts, evals, and native engines.

plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: Vault interface: CLI operations, search, graph-aware distill, and retrieval-verification maintenance — the reference implementation of the vault contract.

plugins.name: readwise
plugins.description: Readwise ingestion for the vault contract: pulls Reader/Classic highlights into origin-prefixed 01_Capture/ notes, with optional GitHub/YouTube enrichment, a daily digest, and pipeline status.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Session-end capture and on-demand distillation into vault memory: archives session records to 00_Memory/sessions/ via a hook, then distills durable notes to 00_Memory/notes/ via a two-phase-review skill.
